description: This file defines an abstract class 'AccountForm' for handling user account forms in Drupal, including form building, language settings, role management, and submission handling.

classes.name: AccountForm
classes.description: Abstract class for user account form handling in Drupal, managing form display, language settings, roles, and submission logic.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing dependencies like entity repository, language manager, entity type bundle info, and time service.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate the form with dependencies from the container.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Builds the user account form, including email, username, password, status, roles, language, and timezone settings.

methods.name: trustedCallbacks
methods.description: Returns list of callback methods that are trusted, e.g., 'alterPreferredLangcodeDescription'.

methods.name: alterPreferredLangcodeDescription
methods.description: Modifies the description of the preferred language widget to include additional info.

methods.name: syncUserLangcode
methods.description: Synchronizes the user's preferred language with the entity language.

methods.name: buildEntity
methods.description: Constructs the user entity from form values, handling roles, language, password, and other fields.

methods.name: getEditedFieldNames
methods.description: Returns list of field names that are edited in the form.

methods.name: flagViolations
methods.description: Flags validation violations for specific fields in the form.

methods.name: submitForm
methods.description: Handles form submission, including cleaning up password reset session data.
